name: αἱ φύσεις
roots: φύσις (from φύω, to grow, to be born); τί (something: the Stoics' highest genus, divided into σώματα, bodies, and ἀσώματα, incorporeals — the λεκτόν among them)

name: σῶμα
roots: σῶμα (in Homer the corpse, later every body; for the Stoics what alone exists, acting or acted upon); τὸ τριχῇ διαστατόν (extended three ways: length, breadth, depth — Diogenes Laertius 7.135)

name: λεκτόν
roots: λέγω (first to gather, to pick out, to lay in order, and so to count and to say — the verb of λόγος); the Stoics' incorporeal that subsists (ὑφίσταται) and does not exist as a body does: what a sentence says

name: φύσις
roots: φύω (to grow, to be born)

name: γένος
roots: γίγνομαι (to come to be, to be born): a kind is a line of what comes to be alike; Aristotle's γένος (genus) above εἶδος (species)

name: τὰ γένη
roots: γένος (a kind), γίγνομαι (to come to be)

name: αἱ γραμμαί
roots: γραμμή (a line drawn, from γράφω, to scratch, to write)

name: πλαίσιον
roots: πλαίσιον (an oblong, a frame, a hollow square of troops); τὸ περιέχον (the containing: Aristotle's place is the limit of what contains)

name: ὕλη
roots: ὕλη (wood, timber — Aristotle's matter)

name: βαρύτης
roots: βαρύς (heavy); βάρος (weight)

name: βίος
roots: βίος (a lived life, a course of life — beside ζωή, life as such)

name: λόγος
roots: λέγω (to gather, to lay in order, to say); ζῷον λόγον ἔχον (the living being that has λόγος: Aristotle, Politics I.2)

name: τὰ τεχνητά
roots: τέχνη (craft, art); Aristotle, Physics II.1: some things are by nature, others through other causes, as by art

name: τὰ ὧν οὐκ ἄνευ
roots: Plato, Phaedo 99b: the cause is one thing, and that without which the cause would not be a cause is another

name: εὐκρασία
roots: κρᾶσις (a mixing) + εὖ (well): the good blend — the physicians' health, and a temperate climate; μεσότης (the mean)

name: ἀναλογία
roots: ἀνά + λόγος (according to ratio); Plato, Timaeus 31c: of bonds the most beautiful, which proportion accomplishes

name: θεμελιώδεις νόμοι
roots: θεμέλιον (a foundation stone) + νόμος (law) — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: βάρος
roots: βαρύς (heavy)

name: ἡ τάξις τῶν σωμάτων
roots: τάξις (an arrangement, a rank in battle, from τάσσω, to array); Aristotle, History of Animals 588b: nature passes little by little from the lifeless to the living

name: χώρα∞χρόνος
roots: χώρα (room: the receptacle of Timaeus 52a); χρόνος (time: 'a moving image of eternity', Timaeus 37d)

name: πεδίον δυνάμεως
roots: πεδίον (a plain); δύναμις (power, force) — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: πεδίον ὕλης
roots: πεδίον; ὕλη (wood, then Aristotle's matter: what a thing is made of)

name: στοιχειῶδες σωμάτιον
roots: στοιχεῖον (a member of a row; a letter; Plato's and Aristotle's element); σωμάτιον (a little body); τὰ ἐλάχιστα (Epicurus: the least parts, themselves without parts) — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: ἁδρόνιον
roots: ἁδρός (thick, strong, full-grown) — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: πυρήν
roots: πυρήν (the stone of a fruit; Modern Greek's nucleus)

name: ἄτομον
roots: ἀ- (not) + τέμνω (to cut): the uncut; Leucippus and Democritus: ἄτομα καὶ κενόν, atoms and void

name: μόριον
roots: μόριον (a part, a portion — Aristotle's word for the parts of animals; Modern Greek's molecule); μοῖρα (a share)

name: κύτταρον
roots: κύτταρος (the cell of a honeycomb, in Aristotle); κύτος (a hollow, a vessel)

name: ἱστός
roots: ἱστός (the web on a loom; the mast, what stands upright — hence histology); ὑφή (a weave)

name: ὄργανον
roots: ἔργον (work); Aristotle, De Anima II.1: the soul is the first actuality of a natural body that has organs (σώματος φυσικοῦ ὀργανικοῦ)

name: σῶμα ἔμψυχον
roots: ψυχή (breath, life); ἔμψυχος (ensouled, alive); Aristotle: the living body is σῶμα φυσικὸν ὀργανικόν, a natural body with organs

name: πληθυσμός
roots: πλῆθος (a multitude, a throng); ἀγέλη (a herd: Aristotle's gregarious animals, ἀγελαῖα) — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: κοινωνία
roots: κοινός (common); Aristotle's κοινωνία: every partnership of the living, the city among them

name: οἰκοσύστημα
roots: οἶκος (a house, a household); σύστημα — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: λόγος
roots: λέγω (to gather, to lay in order, to say); ζῷον λόγον ἔχον (the living being that has λόγος: Aristotle, Politics I.2)

name: ὑλικόν
roots: ὕλη (wood, timber — matter): the material — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: οὐράνιον σῶμα
roots: οὐρανός (the sky, heaven); Aristotle's heavenly bodies, of the fifth body, αἰθήρ

name: πλανητικὸν σύστημα
roots: πλανάομαι (to wander); σύστημα — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: γαλαξίας
roots: γάλα (milk): ὁ γαλαξίας κύκλος, the milky circle (Aristotle, Meteorology I.8)

name: ἐξάρτημα
roots: ἐξαρτάω (to hang from, to fit on); ἐξαρτίζω (to fit out, as a ship is); μέρος (a part)

name: μηχανή
roots: μηχανή (a contrivance, a means, from μῆχος, a remedy, a way); ὄργανον (a tool)

name: στέφανος
roots: στέφω (to encircle, to wreathe)

name: τὸ ἐξ ἀνάγκης ὄν
roots: ἀνάγκη (necessity) + ὄν (being); Aristotle, Metaphysics Λ.7 1072b: the first mover is ἐξ ἀνάγκης ὄν, being of necessity; τὸ ἕν (the One)

name: ἀγάπη
roots: ἀγαπάω (to welcome, to cherish, to be content with); beside ἔρως (desire) and φιλία (friendship); 1 Corinthians 13:5: οὐ ζητεῖ τὰ ἑαυτῆς, it seeks not its own

name: σοφία
roots: σοφός (skilled, wise — first of a craftsman's skill); Proverbs 8 in the Septuagint: wisdom beside the maker as all was made

name: δι' οὗ
roots: διά with the genitive (through); 1 Corinthians 8:6: ἐξ οὗ τὰ πάντα … δι' οὗ τὰ πάντα — from whom all things, through whom all things: the source and the via

name: κατάστασις
roots: καθίστημι (to set down, to establish); στάσις (a standing)

name: διαστάσεις
roots: διΐστημι (to set apart); the Stoics' body is τριχῇ διαστατόν, extended three ways

name: χρόνος
roots: χρόνος (a span of time); for the Stoics one of the four incorporeals, with τόπος (place), κενόν (void) and λεκτόν

name: μῆκος
roots: μῆκος (length; also height, greatness); διάστημα (an interval)

name: πότε
roots: πότε (when: one of Aristotle's ten categories, Categories 1b26)

name: ποῦ
roots: ποῦ (where: the category); τόπος (place: for the Stoics an incorporeal, what a body occupies)

name: τὰ συμπληρώματα
roots: συμπληρόω (to fill up together); πλήρης (full)

name: ῥητόν
roots: ῥητός (stated, said expressly — and in mathematics, rational, what has a stated ratio)

name: ὁ φέρων
roots: φέρω (to bear); ὑποκείμενον (what lies under and bears)

name: σύστημα
roots: συνίστημι (to set together)

name: διαίρεσις
roots: διαιρέω (to take apart); Plato, Phaedrus 265e: to cut where the natural joints are (κατ' ἄρθρα ᾗ πέφυκεν); στιγμή (a point, a prick)

name: αἱ διαιρέσεις
roots: διαιρέω (to take apart)

name: μέρος
roots: μέρος (a part, a share, from μείρομαι, to receive one's portion); ὅλον (the whole)

name: οἰκεῖ ἐν
roots: οἰκέω (to dwell); οἶκος (a house)

name: κεῖται ἐν
roots: κεῖμαι (to lie: Aristotle's category κεῖσθαι, position); τόπος (a place); θέσις (a placing)

name: ὁ κεκτημένος
roots: κτάομαι (to acquire): the possessor; κτῆμα (a possession)

name: ὑπεύθυνος
roots: εὐθύνη (the account an Athenian official gave at the end of office): liable to give account

name: κτῆσις
roots: κτάομαι (to get, to acquire); ὠνή (a purchase)

name: αἱ ἐπιμέλειαι
roots: ἐπιμέλεια (care, attention: Socrates' ἐπιμέλεια ψυχῆς, the care of the soul)

name: νόμιμον
roots: νόμος (law)

name: τεχνικόν
roots: τέχνη (craft, art)

name: ἐμπειρία
roots: πεῖρα (a trial)

name: χρηματικόν
roots: χρήματα (things of use, money: χράομαι, to use)

name: πράξεις
roots: πράσσω (to do, to pass through)

name: ποιηθέν
roots: ποιέω (to make — the root of poetry)

name: παράγωγον
roots: παράγω (to lead aside, to bring forth); the grammarians' παράγωγος (a word formed from another)

name: ἀναγνωσθέν
roots: ἀναγιγνώσκω (to know again, to recognise: to read)

name: λεχθέν
roots: λέγω (to say — the verb of λεκτόν); ῥῆμα (a thing said)

name: προέλευσις
roots: προέρχομαι (to come forth); μαρτυρία (a testimony)

name: στρώματα
roots: στρώννυμι (to spread): a layer spread upon another

name: ἐπαγγελία
roots: ἀγγέλλω (to announce): a public declaration — and a promise

name: νόμος
roots: νέμω (to distribute, to allot: a law is an allotment); θεσμός (what is laid down, from τίθημι)

name: αἰτιολογία
roots: αἰτία (a cause, a charge) + λόγος (an account): the giving of causes

name: ἐφημερίδες
roots: ἐφ' ἡμέρᾳ (upon the day): the day-journals, as Alexander's court kept; διφθέρα (a prepared hide: the writing stuff that gave daftar its name)

name: ἱστορία
roots: ἵστωρ (one who knows by having seen: a witness, a judge)

name: τὰ ἐκκρεμῆ
roots: ἐκκρεμής (hanging from, in suspense): what still hangs undecided

name: ὀνόματα
roots: ὄνομα (a name); Plato's Cratylus: whether names are by nature (φύσει) or by convention (θέσει) — here by convention, for a reader

name: ὄψις
roots: ὄψομαι (I shall see): a sight, an appearance; θέα (a spectacle)

name: φακοί
roots: φακός (a lentil — and the lens)

name: ἀνατολή
roots: ἀνατέλλω (to rise, as the sun): the rising, the east

name: σύνεσις
roots: συνίημι (to send together, to bring together: to see how parts go together)

name: ἐνέργεια
roots: ἐν + ἔργον (at work): Aristotle's being-at-work — what is at work now

name: ἐξέτασις
roots: ἐξετάζω (to examine closely, to test — Apology 38a: ὁ ἀνεξέταστος βίος, the unexamined life)

name: κῆπος
roots: κῆπος (a garden: Epicurus's school); παράδεισος (from Persian pairi-daēza: Xenophon's word for the Persian king's walled parks)

name: ὄνομα
roots: ὄνομα (a name)

name: ὑπό
roots: ὑπό with the genitive (under, by the agency of): the doer of a Greek passive — λεχθὲν ὑπὸ Σωκράτους

name: περί
roots: περί (about, concerning): what the act reaches, or what it is about — ἀντικείμενον is passed over, since in the logic of the squares it names opposites

name: διά
roots: διά with the genitive (through): the means — a tool, a document, words, an agreement; δι' οὗ (through whom) was term:via's

name: πρός
roots: πρός with the accusative (towards, to): what it goes towards, or the one it is for; the dative names the receiver

name: ἀπό
roots: ἀπό with the genitive (away from): the fixed point it departs from; ἐκ (out of: a parent, a source) and παρά with the genitive (from beside: a giver)

name: ἐν
roots: ἐν with the dative (in, at): a position — ἐν τόπῳ, ἐν χρόνῳ — or the being it stands on; ἐπί (upon) and παρά with the dative (beside, in the keeping of)

name: ᾗ
roots: ᾗ (in which way: qua): Aristotle's ᾗ — τὸ ὂν ᾗ ὄν, being qua being (Metaphysics Γ.1): in what capacity, or as what; ὡς (as)

name: λέγειν
roots: λέγω (to gather, to lay in order, to say): to give one's word — whose deed is λεχθέν (acts:said); φάναι (to affirm)

name: ἀναγιγνώσκειν
roots: ἀναγιγνώσκω (to know again, to recognise: to read): what a body read off a thing — whose deed is ἀναγνωσθέν (acts:read)

name: παράγειν
roots: παράγω (to lead aside, to bring forth): whose deed is παράγωγον (acts:derived); συνάγειν (to gather a conclusion: the logicians' inferring)

name: ποιεῖν
roots: ποιέω (to make — the root of poetry): made here from nothing given — whose deed is ποιηθέν (acts:made)

name: εἶναι
roots: εἰμί (to be): where a being is — ποῦ ἐστιν; κεῖσθαι (to lie: term:located_at, which `be` replaces)

name: ἑστάναι
roots: ἵστημι (to set, to stand): ἑστάναι ἐπί, to stand on — what a step stands on, made of it (ἐξ οὗ) or possible on it; στάσις (a standing)

name: μέρος εἶναι
roots: μέρος (a part, a share, from μείρομαι, to receive one's portion) + εἶναι: to be a part of a whole; ὅλον (the whole)

name: ὀνομάζειν
roots: ὄνομα (a name): a namespace names a being; Plato's Cratylus: names by convention (θέσει), as here

name: γίγνεσθαι
roots: γίγνομαι (to come to be): through whom a being came to be — Aristotle, Metaphysics Z.7: all that comes to be comes to be by something, from something, and becomes something (ὑπό τέ τινος γίγνεται καὶ ἔκ τινος καὶ τί); δι' οὗ (term:via, which `come` replaces)

name: κεκτῆσθαι
roots: κτάομαι (to acquire), in the perfect: to have acquired, so to own — whose a being is; ὁ κεκτημένος (term:owned_by, which `own` replaces)

name: λόγον ὑπέχειν
roots: λόγος (an account) + ὑπέχω (to hold under, to submit): to be held to account — who answers for a being, and in which mode; ὑπεύθυνος (term:responsibility, which `answer` replaces)

name: κτᾶσθαι
roots: κτάομαι (to get, to acquire): from whom a being came to us — its perfect, κεκτῆσθαι, is to own (`own`); κτῆσις (term:acquired, which `acquire` replaces); ὠνή (a purchase)

name: μεταφέρειν
roots: μετά + φέρω (to carry across — as Aristotle's μεταφορά carries a name across): statements carried from one layer to another

name: ἀναγκαῖον
roots: ἀνάγκη (constraint): what cannot be otherwise (Metaphysics Δ.5); τὸ ἐξ ἀνάγκης ὄν (crown:theone)

name: ἐνδεχόμενον
roots: ἐνδέχεται (it admits): Aristotle's two-sided possible, Prior Analytics I.13 — neither necessary nor impossible

name: δυνατόν
roots: δύναμαι (to be able): what is not impossible (De Interpretatione 12–13)

name: ἀδύνατον
roots: ἀ + δυνατόν: what cannot be

name: δέον
roots: δεῖ (it is needful, one must): τὸ δέον, what ought to be done — the word deontic is made from

name: ἀφετόν
roots: ἀφίημι (to let go — omittere's own image, ob + mittere): what may be let go, left undone

name: ἐξόν
roots: ἔξεστι (it is allowed, it is open): τὸ ἐξόν, what may be done

name: ἀπειρημένον
roots: ἀπεῖπον (to speak off, to forbid): Aristotle, Nicomachean Ethics V.11 — what the law does not bid, it forbids (ἃ δὲ μὴ κελεύει, ἀπαγορεύει)

name: ὁμολογεῖν
roots: ὁμοῦ + λέγω (to say the same thing): each party's yes; ὁμολογία (an agreement)

name: ἀρνεῖσθαι
roots: ἀρνέομαι (to say no, to refuse): a party's no

name: καταβάλλειν
roots: κατά + βάλλω (to throw down, to pay down): to give an amount; τελεῖν (to pay a due)

name: ἀναδέχεσθαι
roots: ἀναδέχομαι (to take upon oneself): a cost borne, in a share

name: ἐπιτρέπειν
roots: ἐπιτρέπω (to turn over to, to entrust, to permit): to open an act to someone

name: δύνασθαι
roots: δύναμις (power, ability): may, or must, as the square says; δυνατόν is kept for the necessity square's possible

name: προΐστασθαι
roots: προΐστημι (to set before; in the middle, to stand before another, to stand for him): the προστάτης who stood for a metic before Athenian law

name: χρῄζειν
roots: χρεία (need, use): to need something to function; δεῖσθαι (to want) is passed over, since its δεῖ is the permission square's δέον

name: ἐκπληροῦν
roots: ἐκ + πληρόω (to fill full, to fulfil): a need filled

name: χρῆσθαι
roots: χράομαι (to use, to have dealings with): a being, an allowance, a technology; χρήματα (things of use)

name: λειτουργεῖν
roots: λειτουργία (a public service; in later Greek any office, and in Modern Greek a machine's working): to do a job — a router's, a file server's

name: χωρεῖν
roots: χώρα (room): to have room for, to hold — a jar χωρεῖ so many measures: what a being can hold, and what it holds

name: ἐκτελεῖν
roots: ἐκ + τελέω (to carry to its end, to accomplish) — coined: a machine running a program, an instance

name: ἀνοιγνύναι
roots: ἀνοίγνυμι (to open): a session, an account; ἄρχεσθαι (to begin)

name: προάγειν
roots: πρό + ἄγω (to lead forward): a case led forward on its walk

name: βῆμα
roots: βαίνω (to go, to step): a step of a walk, the line a case moves along

name: παρεῖναι
roots: πάρειμι (to be beside, to be present): at an event, which takes the hours of those present

name: μετρεῖν
roots: μέτρον (a measure): a property read, at a moment, through an instrument; Protagoras' man the measure (πάντων χρημάτων μέτρον ἄνθρωπος)

name: ἀναγράφειν
roots: ἀνά + γράφω (to write up — as a city wrote up its decrees on stone): what a line held at each position; ἀναγραφή (a register)

name: λογίζεσθαι
roots: λογίζομαι (to reckon, to count up — λόγος, a reckoning): read each time it is asked, never stored

name: πηγνύναι
roots: πήγνυμι (to make fast, to fix): the moment and the commit a reading was read at, fixed

name: κατατάσσειν
roots: κατά + τάσσω (to set in its rank): a being set in its class by a code of a scheme

name: προσήκειν
roots: πρός + ἥκω (to have come to, to belong to): the person a record is about; οἱ προσήκοντες (one's own people)

name: τιμᾶν
roots: τιμή (worth, price): to assess — as an Athenian court assessed a penalty (τίμησις): how much harm a being can do a person

name: σφάλλεσθαι
roots: σφάλλω (to trip up): a way a being can fail, or is failing — σφάλμα (a slip, a fault)

name: ἐπανορθοῦν
roots: ἐπί + ἀνά + ὀρθόω (to set upright again): a failure set right, where the fix lives

name: κρίνειν
roots: κρίνω (to separate, to judge): a person's ruling on a disagreement — κρίσις

name: ἀποκρίνεσθαι
roots: ἀποκρίνομαι (to answer — the respondent of a dialectical exchange): a verdict on another's reading, or one's words at a hearing

name: σταθμᾶσθαι
roots: σταθμός (a balance): criteria weighed against each other, pair by pair

name: προτείνειν
roots: πρό + τείνω (to stretch forth, to put forward): beans offered to another garden; πρότασις (a proposal)

name: παραλαμβάνειν
roots: παρά + λαμβάνω (to take over what is handed on, as a tradition is received): a proposal taken in, whole; δέχεσθαι (to accept) is not this

name: μελετᾶν
roots: μελέτη (practice, a rehearsal — the declaimers' exercise): a garden holding no facts about the world

name: ὑπηρετεῖν
roots: ὑπηρέτης (an under-rower, an attendant): to serve — coined: listening at an address and a port, through a protocol

name: ὀχεῖν
roots: ὀχέω (to carry, to bear up — ὄχημα, a carriage): coined, a link carrying a tunnel, a disk a volume

name: ὁδηγεῖν
roots: ὁδός (a road) + ἡγέομαι (to lead): to show the way — coined, traffic sent on to its next hop

name: μεταγράφειν
roots: μετά + γράφω (to rewrite, to transcribe): coined, an address rewritten as traffic crosses

name: διηθεῖν
roots: διά + ἠθέω (to strain through — ἠθμός, a strainer): coined for a packet filter, letting traffic cross or stopping it

name: καταχωρίζειν
roots: κατά + χωρίζω (to put in its place: to enter in a register — the papyri's word for entering accounts): an amount booked, in a share

name: ἀνανεοῦν
roots: ἀνά + νέος (new again): a registration renewed — as a treaty was renewed

name: ὁρίζειν
roots: ὅρος (a boundary stone — and a definition): a cell's boundary fixed by a mark at a position

name: ἀπεργάζεσθαι
roots: ἀπό + ἐργάζομαι (to work off, to finish a work): an artifact brought into being — a file, a build, a report

name: διαγράφειν
roots: διά + γράφω (to mark out by lines — as a geometer draws a figure): a page draws

name: ὀχετός
roots: ὀχετός (a conduit for water): coined for a network channel — where it is bound, what it protects, who may reach it

name: ἀντάξιον
roots: ἀντάξιος (worth as much as): what a payment came to in another currency

name: τάγμα
roots: τάσσω (to array): a division, a rank — a class of the Contract of Parts; τάξις is the frame of sayables

name: ῥήτρα
roots: ῥήτρα (a spoken compact — Lycurgus' Great Rhetra; Modern Greek's ρήτρα, a clause): what a clause holds beside its words

name: περιοχή
roots: περιέχω (to encompass): which parts a grant opens, and whether each use states a reason

name: διάγραμμα
roots: διαγράφω (to mark out by lines): a figure — what it draws, its story and its lenses

name: μέθοδος
roots: μετά + ὁδός (a way after, a pursuit): how a reading was made

name: σελίς
roots: σελίς (a column of writing on a roll): a page of drawings

name: θέσις
roots: τίθημι (to set, to place): a placing — what a placement holds there

name: ὕπαρξις
roots: ὑπάρχω (to be there, to be at hand): found, or looked for and not found; παρεῖναι is kept for `attend`

name: λογισμός
roots: λογίζομαι (to reckon): a reckoning — what it selects and computes, read each time

name: ἀποτέλεσμα
roots: ἀποτελέω (to bring to its end): an outcome — what came of a measuring

name: σειρά
roots: σειρά (a cord, a chain — Modern Greek's series): coined for what a line held at each position, row by row

name: λύσις
roots: λύω (to loose): a debt loosed — which occurrences of which clauses a payment settles

name: μερίς
roots: μείρομαι (to receive one's portion): one's portion of a cost

name: ἀξία
roots: ἄξιος (weighing as much): the value a measuring read

name: πορεία
roots: πορεύομαι (to go, to journey): how a walk goes at a step

name: συγκρίσεις
roots: συγκρίνω (to judge together, to compare): the judgments, pair by pair

name: γνώρισμα
roots: γνωρίζω (to make known, to recognise): a token a thing is known by — a statement's in its bean

name: ἐφ' ὅσον
roots: ἐπί + ὅσος (for as much as, for as long as): the statement holds while what it names matches

name: διότι
roots: διὰ τί (on account of what): Aristotle's τὸ διότι, the reason why, beside τὸ ὅτι, the fact (Posterior Analytics I.13) — the reason, in prose

name: σημείωσις
roots: σημειόω (to mark — σημεῖον, a sign): a remark, in prose

name: παρακαταθήκη
roots: παρακατατίθημι (to lay down beside, to entrust): a deposit in trust — kept off git, in a store a host resolves

name: κωδικοθήκη
roots: κῶδιξ (the Byzantine Greek of codex) + θήκη (a case, a store), after βιβλιοθήκη: coined, a codebase

name: προϊόν
roots: πρόειμι (to go forth): what comes forth — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: κοινόν
roots: κοινός (common): a common body — as τὸ κοινὸν τῶν Ἀχαιῶν, the Achaean League

name: πρόσωπον
roots: πρός + ὤψ (what faces one): a face, a mask, then a person

name: δεῖγμα
roots: δείκνυμι (to show): a specimen, one shown of a kind — coined: a running instance of a product

name: ξενιστής
roots: ξενίζω (to receive as a guest): a host — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form

name: εἰκονικὸς ξενιστής
roots: εἰκών (an image — Modern Greek's word for virtual) + ξενιστής: coined, a host in image, not in body

name: τομεύς
roots: τέμνω (to cut): a sector (Archimedes' τομεύς of a circle) — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form, for a domain

name: ὑπηρεσία
roots: ὑπηρέτης (an attendant): a service — coined in this sense

name: πρόγραμμα
roots: προγράφω (to write before, to post publicly): a public notice — coined in this sense, a program a machine runs

name: σχέδιον
roots: σχεδιάζω (to make offhand, to sketch): a draft — Modern Greek's design

name: συνεδρία
roots: σύν + ἕδρα (a sitting together) — the Modern Greek word, in the ancient form, for an agent's session

name: συμβόλαιον
roots: σύμβολον (a token broken between two): a contract — the Athenian courts' word

name: κῆπος
roots: κῆπος (a garden — Epicurus' school): a garden this one records — as section:manifest

name: ἔγγραφον
roots: ἐν + γράφω (written in): a written document

name: συμβάν
roots: συμβαίνω (to come together, to befall): what befell — an event

name: ἐπιγραφή
roots: ἐπιγράφω (to write upon): an inscription, a title — what a bean is called

name: ἐπιτομή
roots: ἐπιτέμνω (to cut short): an abridgement — one sentence of what a bean is

name: πιττάκια
roots: πιττάκιον (a tablet, a label): a bean's tags

name: προθεσμία
roots: πρό + θέσθαι (set beforehand): an appointed day — the day a clause falls due

name: ἐπανάληψις
roots: ἐπαναλαμβάνω (to take up again): how a clause repeats

name: προαγγελία
roots: πρό + ἀγγέλλω (to announce before): how long before it falls due a reader is told

name: ἕξις
roots: ἔχω (to have, to hold — πῶς ἔχει, how it stands): how a clause stands; κατάστασις (term:status) is the retired table's

name: ποσόν
roots: πόσος (how much): Aristotle's category of quantity — money, time, anything

name: διάστημα
roots: διΐστημι (to set apart): an interval — the window in which a clause holds

name: περίοδος
roots: περί + ὁδός (a way round, a cycle): the window an amount is counted within

name: οἱ χρώμενοι
roots: χράομαι (to use): those using — the entries whose spans use the allowance

name: ὅταν
roots: ὅτε + ἄν (whenever): what brings a clause into force — a reading that holds, or the condition in words

name: καθ' ἕκαστον
roots: κατά + ἕκαστος (each by each): the clause occurs once for each bean or entry a reading holds

name: μερὶς ἐκ
roots: μερίς (a portion) + ἐκ (out of): what the clause's amount is a share of

name: σχετικὴ προθεσμία
roots: σχέσις (a holding towards: a relation — the commentators' σχετικός, of Aristotle's πρός τι) + προθεσμία: when a clause falls due relative to another position

name: κατὰ σχῆμα
roots: σχῆμα (a figure, the bearing an actor takes on): every party whose role this is, each bound alike

name: ὑπὲρ τοῦ μέρους
roots: ὑπέρ (on behalf of, for) + μέρος (a part): the part of what the agreement concerns that this clause is for

name: ῥήτρα λυθεῖσα
roots: ῥήτρα (a clause) + λύω (to loose): the clause a payment settles

name: περίπτωσις
roots: περιπίπτω (to fall in with): an incident, a case — which occurrence of the clause it settles

name: ποσὸν ἀποδοθέν
roots: ποσόν (how much) + ἀποδίδωμι (to give back what is owed): how much of the occurrence it settles

name: ὑπόμνημα
roots: ὑπομιμνῄσκω (to remind): a memorandum — a remark on a settlement; σημείωσις is the note beside the roles
